name: repoyeti-web
//test: Web tests run under VITEST via `bun run test` — NOT `bun test`. Bun's native runner has no Vue SFC compiler, so `.vue` imports resolve to a string path and @vue/test-utils crashes (WeakMap key error). Same reason CI uses `bun run test`.

scripts.//build: Builds land in dist-next, then swap-dist renames it over dist. The daemon serves dist live — building in place left it empty/partial for the whole build (the Monaco chunk-404 bug).
scripts.build: node scripts/i18n-check.mjs && vue-tsc -b && vite build --outDir dist-next && node scripts/swap-dist.mjs

//overrides: Do NOT pin brace-expansion to one version. minimatch 5/9 want ^2 (`module.exports = expand`); minimatch 10 — what workbox-build's glob uses — wants ^5 (named `expand` export). A flat 2.1.2 pin made the PWA build throw '(0 , brace_expansion_1.expand) is not a function' inside workbox's globbing, which is only a *warning*: the build stayed green while the precache silently shrank to the 6 public/ files, so the app shell was never cached offline. Bun does not support nested overrides (it warns and ignores them), so each requester must resolve on its own; every line is past the CVE-2025-5889 ReDoS fix (1.1.12 / 2.0.2 / 3.0.1 / 4.0.1), so natural resolution stays patched.
